As Noah, it's your job to regain order & get the animals to sleep until you leave the ark. Your only tool to accomplish this is the food you brought aboard the ark. Can it be done? You bet! But how?

203010.overview:
Mega Marble World is a homebrew Genesis game. It is a puzzle game that consists of 50 rooms where a ball needs to be guided to the exit. Using the four direction keys the ball can be moved in any direction and will automatically follow that path until an obstacle is encountered so the ball cannot be stopped halfway the trajectory. There are no enemies, but a lot of thinking is required to get the ball to reach the exit. There are bottomless pits and traps to take into account as well.

Rather that separate levels, the entire game is shaped like a large dungeon maze where all room are connected on a large world map that can also be consulted. Often rooms have multiple exits and the easiest one is not always the best option to progress. Players also discover multiple paths, portal and secret corridors. The game keeps track of the elapsed time and the number of moves needed. Using a password system it is possible to continue at the last room. Some rooms are very small, but there are also huge ones where the camera zooms out at the start. The goal is to reach the exit of the dungeon in a fast time.

206877.overview: Metal Dragon is a homebrew run 'n gun for the Sega Genesis that parodies 80’s and 90’s pop culture, with direct design influences from classics like Mercs, Desert Assault, and Metal Gear. It was created by Kai Magazine Software and a demo was released in 2021.

207010.overview:
The Arcade Legends Street Fighter II': Special Champion Edition, known as the Play TV Legends Street Fighter 2[4] in the US and the Mega Drive Play TV 3 (メガドライブ プレイTV 3) in Japan, is a Sega Mega Drive "console on a chip" designed and manufactured by Sega Toys. In the West it was distributed by Radica.

The system contains Street Fighter II': Special Champion Edition and the Mega Drive version of Ghouls'n Ghosts built-in. It also comes with two controllers.

207256.overview:
The idea is deceptively simple: Guide a marble down a path without hitting any obstacles or straying off the course. The game is viewed from an isometric perspective, which makes it harder to stay focused on the direction the ball is to follow. There are tight corridors to follow and enemies to avoid. There is a 2-player mode in which players must race to the finish; otherwise you're racing against the clock. 

Atari Games' home console division Tengen produced their own Mega Drive copy for the Japanese market in 1993, which is different to the Electronic Arts version. This Japanese version, which appears to have been produced internally by Tengen of Japan, is much more faithful to the original game and supports the Sega Mouse.

208868.overview: Mega Anser (メガアンサー) is the general-purpose software introduced by Sega in 1990 for use with the Sega Mega Anser.

210422.overview:
More Than a Memory: A Perfect Existence is a hack of Sonic the Hedgehog 2 by KojiChao. It is notable for being one of the first hacks that had Shadow the Hedgehog as a playable character in place of Sonic, he also has a Chao sidekick named Mizu (In the vein of Project Shadow 2) and unlike Project Shadow 2, Shadow's sprites in this hack were incomplete.

As of May 19, 2002, there is only one known release of the hack in celebration of Kojichao's birthday. No new versions of the hack were released since then.

210573.overview: Mortal Kombat Arcade Edition is a hack for Sega Genesis created by Master Linkuei, BillyTime!Games, Chev Chelios and Danilo Dias that modifies and tweaks this classic fighting game from Midway to make it more similar to the original arcade version, with improvements in the graphic, sound and playable section.

213150.overview:
This is a port of the j2me game "Casanova Jr.: Girl on Girl" to the 16-bit game console Sega Mega Drive / Genesis. In essence, this is a visual novel dedicated to the adventures of the modern "Casanova".

There is no pornography in the game (demonstrations of what is under the panties), only erotica. There are 2 languages to choose from: English and Russian.

Unlike the original game, the port has a number of differences: additional scenes, additional melodies from Russian pop music of the 1990s.

213161.overview: Mega Casanova 2 is a visual novel on the 16-bit game console Sega Mega Drive (Genesis). It is dedicated to the seduction of girls and the adventures of a photographer.

214131.overview: Mega Man: The Wily Wars, known in Japan and in some parts of Latin America such as Rockman Mega World, is a 16-white remake for Mega Drive of the Mega Man, Mega Man 2 and Mega Man 3 video games, which had originally been Published for the NES video console.

219411.overview:
Mega Turrican: Director's Cut is an aftermarket re-release of the Sega Mega Drive game Mega Turrican.

The Director's Cut version essentially turns the secret 1-2 level into a regular level, which was the inital developer's intention (as can be seen in the May 18, 1993 prototype) until Konami forced it to be turned into a secret level due to difficulty issues. Despite Konami dropping from publishing the game and the later Amiga conversion keeping it as a regular level, the level was still kept secret when Data East picked up the game for publishing, something the Director's Cut version finally restores back. It also broughts some other hidden/unused features like the carbonite Sonic the Hedgehog and Super Mario sprites present in the 1-1 level, which had been created for the game and featured in certain magazines during the development of the game, but end up being unused in the regular game (probably due to licensing issues).

This cartridge also features the regular release of the game and a Score Attack variant with a new level created from the ground up for this release, based on the first world.

419067.overview:
Mega Man: The Sequel Wars is a fan-made homebrew remake of Mega Man 4, 5 and 6 for the Sega Mega Drive, following in the footsteps of the officially released Mega Man: The Wily Wars. It aims to carefully recreate the NES classics while giving them a fresh 16-bit coat of paint and a rearranged soundtrack. It also aims to improve on the foundation of Wily Wars by enhancing both the presentation and gameplay.

Episode Red is the first release of the project, containing the full remake of Mega Man 4. Alongside the original game's content, a slew of new features are added to spice up the experience for returning players.

NOTE: this is not a rom hack of Wily Wars! It is fully coded from scratch in C using the SGDK library. As such, the game will be distributed as full ROM releases as there is no original game to patch to.


FEATURES

-Faithful recreations of the original games, with extensive research done to make everything accounted for.

-Smooth controls that avoid all of the shortcomings of the original Wily Wars and its control issues.

-Refined 16-bit graphics that use the Mega Drive's superior visual capabilities to their fullest, with detailed environments and elaborate parallax backgrounds.

-Original soundtrack featuring both remakes of the original tunes and all-new compositions. Comes in both Classic (original Wily Wars style) and Modern (Regular) flavours.

-New characters to play - including Proto Man who can deflect bullets with his shield, and Roll who uses her broom to mop up enemies in close range.

-More gameplay options including the ability to use any weapon from 4-6!

Please read the included readme file for instructions on how to run the game.

420320.overview: Mario 3: Around the World (Mario 3: Вокруг света) is a unlicensed Mario-based platformer developed by BMB and published by KDS (Kudos). The game begins with an intro involving a mysterious cloud appearing over the Mushroom Kingdom and kidnapping Princess Peach; Mario then finds out from one of the Toads that Wario is behind all of this, and then sets off to rescue the Princess.

420392.overview: Mario 4: A Space Odyssey (Mario 4: Космическая Одиссея [Kosmicheskaya Odisseya]) is a hack of Mario 3: Around the World also developed by BMB and published by KDS. While this game adds a few changes, it plays pretty much the same as Mario 3: Around the World did. Mario 4: A Space Odyssey's plot has Mario and Luigi watching the stars until a star crashes onto the ground. An Alien creature (despite the intro depicting multiple Shroobs from Mario and Luigi: Partners in Time, the text only states one) warns Mario and Luigi about an oncoming threat and that they need to stop the conqueror of galaxies with their army. (However, in-game there is no army that fight alongside Mario and Luigi).

423826.overview:
The sequel to the original Mega Marble World released in 2018.

This is a puzzle. You control the ball. You can roll it in 4 directions. The ball is uncontrollable until it stops. You are only able to make a direction change when you hit a surface - it is straight line movements all the way.

Player might have to revisit locations or choose from multiple paths to finish the level. There can be a sequence of challenges that a player must solve to complete the level. Each level has a set of challenges to get around such as pits and other problems.

Some passages are closed by a magical barrier. Use a magic stone to destroy the magic barrier. There are four types of barriers that differ in color. It is necessary to use a magic stone of the corresponding color. There is a universal magic stone - multi-colored.

424141.overview: Developed by TheRoboZ, this homebrew version of R-Type brings the classic 1987 shoot 'em up masterpiece to the Sega Mega Drive/Genesis, a platform that never saw an official port back in the day. R-Type, hailed as one of the best side-scrolling shooters of all time, has now found its way onto the beloved Mega Drive, thanks to the dedication of passionate developers. Experience the heart-pounding action of eight thrilling levels, equipped with your trusty R-9 ship armed with a devastating plasma gun. Face off against waves of enemies and their deadly machines, using Droid Units to enhance your firepower in the face of monstrous challenges. Immerse yourself in the nostalgia of this iconic game, complete with its unforgettable soundtrack, and relish the opportunity to pilot your way through a gaming classic.

424560.overview:
A special adaptation of the famous SNK's classic Run'n'Gun for the amazing SEGA Megadrive/Genesis !! 

    A typical survival / Scoring funny gameplay with frantic action and progressive difficulty !
    A special Ranking system !
    Try to free the prisoner to gain a whole arsenal of powerful weapons !!
     Fight against various enemies as well as air units !
    Your best scores will be saved for challenges with your friends ( Need SRAM support  ! )
    FM Musics by Vetea & MrData, SFX by Vetea.
    Code by Vetea. Powered with the famous  SGDK by Stephane Dallongeville.
    Graphics ©SNK and adapted for the Megadrive by Vetea.
    50 / 60 Hz compatible game.

448890.overview:
The "Mega Man X in Sonic 2" ROM hack is a creative and exciting mashup of two iconic video game franchises: Capcom's Mega Man X and SEGA's Sonic the Hedgehog 2. In this fan-made modification, players can experience the high-speed platforming of Sonic 2 while controlling Mega Man X, the protagonist from the Mega Man X series.

The ROM hack allows Mega Man X to retain many of his unique abilities, such as the X-Buster for shooting enemies, dashing, and wall climbing. These abilities are seamlessly integrated into the levels of Sonic 2, providing a fresh and challenging gameplay experience. Players can navigate through familiar Sonic 2 zones like Emerald Hill and Chemical Plant while utilizing Mega Man X's advanced mobility and combat skills.

452648.overview: Mortal Kombat II Unlimited is a full scale hack of the Sega Genesis Mortal Kombat II game, which added many new graphical features.

452967.overview:
Platformer game in development for Mega Drive/Sega Genesis

Mangangá game was the first step to form our group: Mangangá Team.

It had a first development in middle 2018. It has a really rough version for download. Its production get delayed because we start to make Devwill Too.

In 2020 Mangangá game is back to work, it uses most graphics made in 2018 and follows for basis of development the PC version of 2019.

The team:
- Laudelino: code.
- Paulo Villalva: graphics.
- Luiz Villalva: tests and BUGs search.
- Casemiro Azevedo: musics.

452977.overview: Sega Mega Drive/Genesis version of Monkey Lad, a game based on Alex Kidd in Miracle World, created around the art assets by Surt, that uses the Scorpion Engine.

456092.overview:
Mega Flappy Sis

by Lennart Borg (formerly Brink-Abeler)

The first ever game by Beetroot games.

Update January 2018:

     2 player mode
     hardcore mode
     some bug-fixes (most only show on real hardware) 


This game was developed for the Sega Mega Drive or Sega Genesis (US).

You will need an emulator to run it on modern systems.

Based on the original Flappy Bird by Dong Nguyen (2013)

Created using:

    Notepad++

I hope to create a cartridge of this game with complete box art and stuff.

Have fun crashing that poles :-)

457624.overview:
OPERATION INTRUDE! FIND AND DESTROY METAL GEAR...

OUTER HEAVEN is the name of a heavily armed land in the depths of southern Africa where the dreadful weapon called METAL GEAR is developed. It is the mission of SOLID SNAKE, one of the members of the secret army 'FOX HOUND' to sneak into OUTER HEAVEN and destroy METAL GEAR. GO AHEAD SOLID SNAKE!

Based on a full and commented disassembly by Manuel Pazos of the original MSX2 game cartridge, this SEGA Genesis port has been built to ensure as near a perfect conversion as possible. Gameplay elements remain intact while additional features have been layered on-top to ensure the fullest experience possible of Metal Gear on the SEGA Genesis. 

• Multiple game modes: English Remix Fan Translation, Original European Version, Original Japanese Version and New Spanish Translation.
• Enhanced Soundtrack and SFX by Ice Dragon Dee, Inglebard and h0ffman.
• No slow-downs or sprite flicker.
• All new ending / credits section.
• Supports 3 and 6 button controllers and saving.

457631.overview:
Mosaico (lit. Mosaic) is a puzzle game, developed by Devworks Game Technology and published by Tec Toy. It was released as a built-in game on several Sega Mega Drive models released in Brazil.

Mosaico is a clone of 15 Puzzle: In this game, the player must order all the pieces from the figure correctly, as shown in the instructions screen. A move counter at the top-right side of the screen is also available. Doing the puzzle correctly shows a congratulatory message before going to the title screen again.

457633.overview:
A vampire survivor clone I made for the sega genesis.

This is my first attempt at programming and pixel art, so expect some bugs here and there, this is mostly a game for my portfolio, i'll still update it every now and then.

The game features 6 bosses, one map and a few upgrades, I wish I could add more

but the Genesis could not handle it, the low mob count on the screen is also due to hardware limitations.

No music yet, I still don't know how to make it, plan on adding it eventually once I figure it out.

457646.overview: This is a fan port of Splatterhouse I've been working on to learn the ropes of Sega Megadrive/Genesis development.

457766.overview:
This fun patch is designed for Ms. Pac-Man for the Sega Genesis. It is designed to randomize multiple aspects of the game.

How It Works:
——————–
After the first stage, Level, Maze Type and Difficulty are randomized. This will continue until game over.

458072.overview: Dimitris stood in front of the mansion for almost a whole minute without moving.

458081.overview:
Mighty Mighty Missile! is just another commercially-released Sega CD port of a Genesis homebrew demake of a Game Boy Advance remake of a Dreamcast original: ChuChu Rocket!

Yeah, one of those. 

The final Genesis version was released as a ROM that was included on the SEGA CD version's disc.

458110.overview: A playful platformer with surprising mechanics and a unique twist; as Slow Mole you can get a checkpoint on any screen, but only if you beat the timer. Each level requires speed and strategy.

458161.overview: A retro racing game for Mega Drive/Genesis. Powered by SGDK.

458183.overview: Unlock the potential of your Sega console with mikeyeldey95.

459502.overview:
This is an overhaul patch for Mortal Kombat II which explores the idea of characters having additional gameplay quirks to them.

Character Perks:
——————–
Liu Kang, Kung Lao and Mileena – XP System: (Human Players Only)
Players deal one extra point of damage every 2 wins. Level cap is at 14 wins.

Sub-Zero – Defense Buff:
Attacks against Sub-Zero are reduced in damage by two points.

Johnny Cage – Split Shot:
Johnny Cage’s groin attack deals 50% damage.

Kitana – Deadly Fans
Kitana’s fans deal much more damage.

Baraka – Deadly Blades
Baraka’s blades deal much more damage.

Jax – Attack Buff:
Attacks performed by Jax deal an extra 3 points of damage.

Raiden – Faster Uppercuts: (Human Players Only)
No delay after uppercutting an opponent.

Shang Tsung – Life Steal
Shang Tsung regenerates a small amount health after a successful attack.

Reptile – Regenerating Health
Every second, Reptile regenerates a small portion of health.

Scorpion – Attack Buff
Attacks performed by Scorpion deal an extra 2 points of damage.

AI Nerf:
——————–
By selecting a difficulty setting in the options menu,
the AI adjusts itself depending on which difficulty level was selected.

All difficulties are now heavily toned down compared to the retail release in terms of AI Difficulty
and will be less likely to read inputs and counter you.

Difficulty does not scale with this patch.

Simple Stage Fatals:
——————–
At the end of a Match, players can simply uppercut an opponent in The Deadpool, Kombat Tomb or Pit II and perform a stage fatality. This operates similar to MK1’s Pit mechanics.

Stage Fatality inputs are still accepted and work as intended.

459841.overview:
Mobius Evolution is a heavy modification of Sonic the Hedgehog for the Sega Mega Drive created by Abyssal Leopard with the help of fellow members. The aim of this hack was initially to be a simple level layout hack, but it eventually acquired new features, such as innovative gimmicks, boss battles and other things the player might discover in gameplay.

It was a hot summer. Sonic was in Mobius enjoying his vacations after a long time of peace, and so was Blaze. Everything seemed to go flawlessly, until… They began to watch how everything was being destroyed. Of course, Sonic and Blaze found who would do this obvious, Dr. Eggman, the fat scientist who Sonic beat a million times, and who Blaze also knows very well. Once again, the dictator used plenty of innocent creatures to create his robots to impede any kind of opposition in his plans to conquer the whole world. Now it’s up to you to save those poor animals!

460033.overview: Mega Cyber-Lip (Alpha Prototype) by Twin Eagles Group

460924.overview: Megarunner is an endless runner for the Sega Mega Drive

462279.overview: Mean Bean Tsuu is a hack which aims to be a sequel to the original game, featuring new mechanics from Puyo Puyo Tsuu, as well as a story more in line with that of Japanese Classic Sonic canon. It still follows Mean Bean's original mechanics, though research is being done to get those Tsuu mechanics in!

462453.overview: From the underground of the island, comes the one and only Miner Mole. Travel across the world with its valuable pickaxe and save the island from the evil that is invading it. Visit forests, mines, caves, cities, and even hidden dungeons. Defeat all kinds of enemies and end up defeating the monster who is sending them.

462904.overview: An unlicensed/bootleg mod of Mortal Kombat developed and published in China by Glorysun.

464608.overview: This is a faithful fan-made port of the classic arcade hit Super Pang (1990)

465301.overview: Grab enemies with your spaceship's hook and throw them at each other in this little but fun game! Play solo to see how long you last, or get help from a friend while also competing to get the highest score!

465375.overview: Meteors are falling from the sky!

465628.overview: A puzzle platformer for the sega mega drive/genesis, where you destroy all of the numbered platforms in each level to win.

465655.overview: Mega Castlevania IV port to the Sega Mega Drive/Sega Genesis

465664.overview: The objective is to collect as many skulls as you can. You can't collect them while they're on fire, so you'll have to bop them with an arrow first.

465667.overview:
You thought it was just another boring afterschool meeting. You were wrong.
Ms. Bell, your eccentric teacher, has brought an ancient relic of the 20th century—a Simon Game—and she’s dead serious about playing it.

466575.overview: Madagascar 3 is a Russian hack of a Sega Mega Drive game called A Dinosaur's Tale made by TOF.

469322.overview: This is a 2 player strategic board game for the sega mega drive/genesis that plays on a 7x7 grid. there are two piece colors, red (player 1) and blue (player 2). at the starts of a new game, red always starts first. pieces can be cloned (1 step) or jumped (2 step). after a turn, the opponent's pieces adjacent to the moving player are changed to a new color (e.g. red turns blue, blue turns red).

470282.overview:
Here is a “mega” hack that includes the best features released over the past few years plus a few that worked on the PAL version exclusively. IPSPeek was helpful to isolate the ability to slide in MM1&2 and having 5 buster shots on screen from the old patches. The previous weapon restock patches dont always work properly. Use Retro-Bit if playing on real hardware because of slowdown fixes and Genesis Mini if playing on emulation (with cpu overclocking enabled to reduce slowdown). Try the MD+ soundtrack by MET for the “Mega” experience!

This hack includes the following features:

* Enemy invulnerability time has been all but eliminated
* Improves Buster Fire Speed
* The Buster and some boss weapons can be fired more rapidly
* Mega Man pulls his Buster back a little sooner after firing
* Mega Man can have 5 bullets on screen at once, instead of 3
* Adds the Slide to Mega Man 1 and 2
* Refill weapon energy after death
* Redraws all of Proto Man’s sprites
* Optional Mega Hack MD+ patches
* Optional Weapon Master patch that has been edited to work on any version of the game and a few of the glitches fixed (be careful still of switching weapons when entering the level and boss rooms or when battling the copy robot)
* Optional retranslated Wily Tower text

471603.overview:
Mighty Morphin Power Rangers in Streets of Rage 2.

Features:

* Characters replaced with 6 rangers.
* All rangers have a huge range of unique attacks
* All playable characters can run and change direction and turn around while running.
* All playable characters can jump further while running.
* The command to run (f, f) becomes more sensitive.
* If the player presses A while running, the player’s character will perform Offensive Special.
* Charge attacks require holding B for only 2/3 second.
* You can use the Defensive Special and Offensive Special when you capture the enemy.
* You can use the Defensive Special and Offensive Special when grabbing an enemy from behind.
* Mania and Very Easy difficulty is directly accessible.
* Stage selection is available.
* You can choose the same characters.
* Added 6-Button gamepad Support. Back attack now is Y-button
* Recovery from enemy knockdown (Push C while knocked)
* Changed jump kicks to dive kicks
* Added Turbo Mode
* 90% of enemies and bosses are changed to Power Rangers enemies & bosses
* Intro, title, and ending animations are changed to tie up with Power Rangers
* Beating game on Hardest or Mania difficulty will unlock a new character (White Ranger). Trigger A+C buttons on cursor over the Green Ranger.

472057.overview:
Ms. Bell’s Music Class is a lighthearted, character-driven quiz game where you try to identify background music from SEGA Mega Drive titles.
No vocals, no remixes—just pure, nostalgic FM sound straight from the golden age of 16-bit gaming!

Play through a fully-voiced (text-only) comedy-style scenario featuring the familiar cast from
“Or Maybe This Is the Perfect Life”—this time dragged into an unexpected after-school “music appreciation” session run by Ms. Bell.

Except it’s not music appreciation.
It’s a three-choice Name That Tune battle, and you’re the one answering all the questions!

And yes, she won’t let you go home until you get them all right…

472172.overview: Take control of an autonomous cleanup robot on a hazardous mission to decontaminate the planet!

472868.overview: Help Mai get rid of viruses with pills, line up 4 slots of the same color horizontally or vertically to destroy them and progress through the levels in this classic puzzle game!

472938.overview:
Ms. PAC-MAN is the iconic arcade game that took the world by storm in 1982. With her pink bow and power pellets, she's a gamer favorite who's still going strong today. Experience the thrill of the chase as you eat your way through mazes full of ghosts. With its simple yet addictive gameplay, Ms. PAC-MAN is a game that everyone can enjoy. 

This is an officially licensed port of Ms. Pac-Man that was released by My Arcade as a dedicated handheld. The handheld is based off the architecture of Sega Genesis/Megadrive clones, and as such the game's rom file is compatible with Sega Genesis systems and emulators. The default orientation of the screen in emulators is turned 180 degrees. When the game is booting up, holding the A and C buttons will open a special menu where the screen's orientation can be changed.

473576.overview: The game keeps the real rules of chess, including legal movement, check, checkmate, stalemate, castling, en passant, and promotion, but wraps every match in a campaign structure with monsters, level themes, story outcomes, and cinematic audio.

475175.overview:
Mortal Kombat Arcade Edition v1.0a is the definitive version made by Linkuei.

With his permission, Rael G.C. made some graphical improvements:

* Moved the character names to the lifebar.
* Improved Kano, Rayden, Liu Kang, Sub-Zero, Scorpion and Sonya at the character selection screen in order to get closer to the arcade.
* Improved Sub-Zero fatality to show the front size of the heads.
* Reduce the “greenness” of the Goro’s Lair new parallax.
* Fixed Johnny Cage skin colors.
* Improved Battleplan avatar for Shang Tsung, Goro, Sub-Zero, Scorpion, Liu Kang, Johnny Cage, Kano.
* Reworked Rayden stance animation and victory standing, restoring the “blue” eyes.
* Reworked Scorpion/Sub-Zero head on victory standing.
* Reworked Sub-Zero sprites on stance animation and victory standing.
* Improved The Pit cloud colors to match the arcade.
* Fixed Sub-Zero walking animation (it was broken, with disappearing arms).
* Fixed Sonya belly, hair and shoes colors.
* Fixed Liu Kang stance animation and victory standing.
* Fixed Kano victory animation (first frame was 2 pixels misplaced to the bottom).
* Restored Throne Room dragons statues.
* Removed a red line from Johnny Cage when following from the Pit bridge.
* Cleaned pink spots from Sonya ending screen #1.
* Improved Kano ending screen #2.
* Fixed Sonya broken leg animation while knocked waiting for fatality
* Improved Rayden ending screen #1 and #2 (improved lightning, blue eyes and face lining)
* Small improvement to Liu Kang ending screen #2 (the blurred faces at the background)
* Removed Kano red spots from all sprites
* Removed Rayden yellow spots from all sprites
* Removed Sonya pink spots from all sprites
* Removed SubZero red spots from all sprites
* Removed J. Cage green spots from all sprites
* Removed Liu Kang red spots on this “shoes” from all sprites
* Made the Genesis soundtrack order the default option
* Applied BillyTime!/IEQualShane patch for third party six button controllers compatibility
* Applied BillyTime!/SPKLeader patch to fix SRAM code (fix Picodrive boot)
* Fixed checksum

476085.overview: This hack restores all the content that got censored in the American version of this game back to their original format.

476578.overview: A Sega Mega Drive/Genesis port/demake of an extremely obscure  browser puzzle game from the late 2000s/early 2010s called Pushori, originally created by Tony pa.  match two or three spheres of the same color vertically to make them explode and score points.  they can be pushed by the thrown sphere. horizontal and diagonal matches are not accepted in this game. light up all the squares in a 3x3 grid to advance to the next level, and more sphere colors will be introduced later!

479812.overview: MegalDoom is a Doom-inspired first-person shooter built for the Sega Mega Drive / Genesis. It is a technical experiment in bringing textured 3D-style environments, doors, enemies, items, music and sound effects to the console's hardware limits.

479826.overview: 2 Player hack for Mega Bomberman, allowing for co-op play.

479841.overview:
This is a demo match-3 game for the Sega Genesis / Mega Drive.
It has 9 levels and the start of the simple story.

479857.overview:
This is the version of Mystic Quest's rom I have been working on for the Japan Game Festival in Lyon.
It's still a work in progress, now that I finished revamping the most important part (the battle system) I can finally continue with the project. This game is kinda special to me because it was one of the few RPGs released in french that I played back then on the SNES, alongside Secret of Mana and Zelda.

480088.overview: MegaBox Reloaded is a new 16-bit adventure based on the BOX series originally created by BEYKER SOFT for the ZX Spectrum.

480180.overview: Mega Tetris reimagines the legendary block puzzle as an arcade combat experience exclusive to the Sega Genesis/Mega Drive. Far from being a simple clone, this title fuses the millimetric precision of classic Tetris with the intensity of a one-on-one fighting tournament, all rendered within the constraints and charm of 16-bit hardware.

480340.overview: Collect the flashing bulbs consecutively to build increasingly valuable scoring chains. Move quickly, take risks and don't miss the special items that appear throughout the game if you want to push your score even higher.

480442.overview:
The game is designed to capture the simple gameplay and limited visual style of early home video games. The Mechanical Beasts' attack is causing steel beams to come crashing down!

Keep moving and avoid the falling beams.
Survive long enough, and the path to the Pilder will open!

480545.overview: It's a MD-on-a-chip (SOC) and there's some Flash memory where the console menu (a #Genesis ROM) and the 120 #MasterSystem games are stored.

480547.overview: A game about two Alliance rapid-response operatives engaged in an unequal battle against a rival race for a planet's resources.

481077.overview:
This is the eighth game in the “Or Maybe This Is the Perfect Life” series.

This time, the game is inspired by Namco's classic arcade game Rally-X, with the goal of naturally incorporating its gameplay into the story of the series.

Along with the usual chaotic adventures of the familiar cast, the game features Rally-X-style gameplay where you dodge pursuing cars and rocks while collecting flags scattered around the course.

481841.overview:
This game is an unauthorized fan-made conversion of Capcom's arcade game *Commando* and must be distributed free of charge.

The C64 music tracks listed in the Sound Test as "COMMANDO", "CLEAR", and "HI SCORE" are based on Rob Hubbard's original compositions.

482068.overview: Mega Sudoku is a classic puzzle experience built from the ground up for the Sega Mega Drive / Genesis. Challenge your mind and enjoy hours of brain-teasing fun right on your favorite 16-bit retro console!

482211.overview: MERCS reborn as a twin-stick shooter. Move and fire in any direction, like Xeno Crisis, or strafe while you shoot, like Shock Troopers. Plus high score tables that finally work, saved to SRAM, and arcade animations the Genesis port left out.

482787.overview:
Let's be honest: the first Street Fighter is a legend, but it's not a great game. Stiff controls, pressure-pad buttons, a cast you could never play, two playable fighters who are basically the same guy. It started everything, and almost nobody goes back to it.

So I set out to make a bad game play great.

Street Fighter MD puts the entire 1987 game, with its cast, its moves, its stages, its music and its sounds, inside the engine of Street Fighter II' Special Champion Edition on the Mega Drive / Genesis. SF1's look and soul, on the controls and combat that made SF2 a classic.

482800.overview: Well, wait no longer... this is Mega Ghosts'n Goblins, my reworked version of the Ghosts'n Goblins Mega Drive / Genesis port. It runs on real hardware and accurate emulators, it's a lot faster, and it adds co-op with Maximo and the whole campaign playable as Firebrand, the Red Arremer. I've also got a favor to ask: see I need artists! below.
